entries.text: Result bundles now export per-query ms with seven significant digits instead of one decimal place, so Power@Size derived from exported timings matches the recorded value within 0.01%.
details: Previously sub-10 ms queries were rounded to 0.1 ms, which skewed derived Power@Size by up to about 1.4% on small subscale runs.
Aggregate statistics such as total_ms and avg_ms keep their existing rounding.
